title: A Coefficient Calculus for Unitary (g,K)-Modules of SU(2,2)
summary: We develop an explicit operator and coefficient calculus for admissible (g,K)-modules of SU(2,2), where g = sl(4,C) and K = S(U(2) x U(2)). The K-types are indexed by triples (n,k,m). We introduce operators A_delta and B_delta associated with the noncompact roots, together with auxiliary operators Q and R. We establish their commutator relations, the central coefficient relations, and, in the unitary setting, the corresponding adjoint and norm-factor identities.
